project_info.name: Afada Medical
project_info.purpose: Product management application with worker tracking and sales statistics.

module.name: HomePage Refactoring
module.details: Integrated dynamic statistics for daily/monthly revenue and worker management. Implemented responsive charts using fl_chart. Added localization support for Uzb, Rus, and Kiril languages.

module.name: UI Locking (Coming Soon)
module.details: Added a custom `_buildLockedOverlay` widget providing a dark blurred overlay with "Tez orada" (Coming soon) text. Applied locking to the "Qarzdorlik" (Debt) card and the main Floating Action Button (FAB) on the HomePage. Updated localization maps for all supported languages to include the "Tez orada" string.

module.name: Worker Management
module.details: Refactored `IshchiProvider` for API synchronization. Cleaned up Worker management UI in `draver_ishchilar_pages.dart`.

module.name: Backend Integration
module.details: Implemented product deletion in `ApiService`. Refactoring providers for full API sync.

file.change: Applied locking overlay to FAB and Debt stat card.
Updated `_localizedTexts` with "Tez orada" translations for Uzb, Rus (Скоро), and Kiril (Тез орада).

next_steps.step: Perform end-to-end testing of Products and Workers modules.
Finalize requirements for the locked "Qarzdorlik" module.
Complete backend synchronization for all providers.
